levels.description: Smallest, slight build at one third of canvas height. Patched workwear, empty belt and one plain unlit ceramic bomb, cautious right-facing posture; no armor or effects.
levels.title: Shell Spark

levels.description: Taller and sturdier at two fifths of canvas height; gains leather bracers and a bomb-bandolier with an upgraded ceramic charge. More confident stance, tiny turquoise gleam only.
levels.title: Fuse Climber

levels.description: Larger and broader at half canvas height. Layered iron-and-leather armor, signature bronze-caged Aether bomb and fitted charge belt; planted posture with tight turquoise pressure rings.
levels.title: Aether Bombardier

levels.description: Largest and broadest at three fifths of canvas height, still spacious. Ornate full armor, legendary-quality Aether bomb and complete charge harness; commanding posture and strong close-bound luminous pressure rings.
levels.title: Tideburst Paragon

prompt: A goblin with a bomb affinity
theme: Reach Shell-native practicality, Aether pressure and tidal-ring motifs; interpretive sage green, faded ochre, warm gray, worn leather, cream cloth, iron, aged bronze and ceramic, with pale turquoise Aether accents in advanced stages. Soft watercolor on paper.
